# NalamDesk Docs

> Offline-first practice management for small clinics. Encrypted local vault, no cloud records.

- User Guide: https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/user-guide/intro
  - Initial Setup (vault creation): https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/user-guide/initial-setup
  - Admin Management (users, roles, security, catalogs, ABDM, audit): https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/user-guide/admin-management
  - Clinic Operations (registration, queue triage, vitals, consultation): https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/user-guide/clinic-operations
  - Daily Collection and Day Close (receipts, review queue, ledger): https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/user-guide/daily-collection
  - Merging Duplicate Charts (preview, rollback, archive): https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/user-guide/patient-merge
- Data and Backups (schedule, retention, restore, Drive): https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/backups
- Developer Guide: https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/developer-guide/local-setup
  - Architecture (Electron, Fastify :3000, SQLCipher, RBAC): https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/developer-guide/architecture
  - Database Schema (migrations, ledgers, identifiers): https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/developer-guide/database-schema
  - Testing Strategy (vitest workspaces, Playwright E2E): https://sankara-sabapathy.github.io/nalamdesk/docs/developer-guide/testing-strategy
- Marketing site: https://nalamdesk.com/
- Source: https://github.com/sankara-sabapathy/nalamdesk (AGPL-3.0)
